title: Audit of c34's nematic-cargo (SIBWD): replicates on unused seeds 21-22 and a true 1.5x grid; a ring-off control (chis=0, kappa kept) expels the cargo (in/out 0.25), so the wall is the self-made ring, not the imposed coupling alone
summary: Construction: read world.py line by line. Division and rod shape come from the extensile active stress with an Oono-type feed kr(phi_b - phi) (no division rule); the surfactant source is on rod pixels only, its interfacial layer comes from an adsorption drift written against the body field (chis Ds s grad(1-phi^2)); the cargo's exclusion is an imposed chemical-potential term ln c + kappa s; neither s nor c acts back on the rods. The doubtful capability was W: does the cargo stay in because of the ring or because of the kappa coupling to any surfactant? With the adsorption removed (chis=0, kappa=20, seed 21, same bodies) the surfactant fills the rods (inside 0.25 > rim 0.19) and the coupling pushes the cargo OUT: in/out 0.25, 0% of body-frames or daughters >= 2x, below even the kappa=0 ablation (1.4). With the ring, inside s (0.14) is still above the near bath (0.07), so a pure partition would also expel it (Boltzmann 0.24); the 12x retention is the ring peak (0.39) acting as a kinetic barrier around a rod-made source. Replication on seeds 21 and 22: 25/24 persistent splits, generation 5/4, ring 100% of body-frames, cargo in/out 12.6/13.0, 100% of daughters >= 2x five frames after birth; a true 1.5x grid (dx 0.667, 192^2, seed 22): ring 100%, cargo 8.3, daughters 8.8, and the cargo core, a 1-px spine at dx=1, resolves into a smooth 2-3 px core that splits between the daughters.

verdicts.limitation: W stays by construction in its selectivity: the cargo's aversion to s is written into its chemical potential (ln c + kappa s), so the wall's chemistry is imposed even though the ring that makes it a barrier is self-made (shown by chis=0). B's layer comes from an adsorption drift written against the body field; it counts through the rod-only source (L3 self-made clause). The ring and wall do no work for the rod: s and c act back on nothing in this world. The containment is leaky and kinetic (cargo decays at kcd=0.005; most cargo is in the bath at any time, as the author states). sd_individuals' outside band (2-4 px) sits just past the ring where cargo is depleted, but the far bath (8-14 px) has similar cargo (0.18-0.22 vs 0.13-0.20), so the ratio is not inflated much. The 1.5x grid run is T=600 and one seed.
